description: Breastplate of Bloodthirst Level 60 In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item. Requirements: - Frayed Abomination Stitching x 10 - Arcanite Bar x 5 - Skin of Shadow x 5 - Money: 50
name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
